lines.x: Smithy, quick! Make haste and record what I'm about to say! This could be purrhaps the only record of a Rathalos hunt in Terra!
Mrow!
This is the furst Terra Research Commission! And I am its leader, the Felyne Scholar!
Mrow?
What's wrong, Smithy? Isn't it natural that I be the leader? Unsatisfied? Mrow! Then you can be the Chief Artisan!
Anyway, enough of that! We stand on the furfront of the hunt... behind a rock on the frontlines!
The ultimate showdown is happening right befur our eyes!
On one side we have the King of the Skies! On the other we have the local fledgling Terran Hunters, accompanied by a self-purrclaimed battle-hardened Felyne, the Palico!
Though it seems like the Rathalos will win... the current situation is intense beyond imeowgination! Both sides enter the white-hot stage of flames! Are mew writing this all down, Smithy?
Mrow!
And now we see, the Palico has dodged the Rathalos's attack... Splendid! Its attention has been drawn away!
Seizing the opportunity, Noir Corne rushes towards the Rathalos's tail, and raises his Long Sword! And then!
And then!
He's sent flying!
Purrthetic!
Noir Corne... seems to be fumbling his moves, so let's see how the other is faring. Yato waits for the Rathalos to attack him, and strikes it from the side!
She cleverly dodges its attack, manages to reach its underside, and aims for her target! The Rathalos's right wing!
However! It suddenly takes to the air and breathes a huge jet of flame! Her attack has been neutralized, what a pity.
Mrow!
Ah, now Noir Corne is once again attacking the Rathalos! This time he does not miss, and the Long Sword ruthlessly cuts into the Rathalos's tail!
However... he seems not to have controlled his strength, and was blown away by the Rathalos's tailspin.
That's twice already...
But! He stands! The soul of a fighter burns brightly! And he goes in for another round!
Corne!
I-I'm fine, my chest just feels a little tight *cough*—
Stop looking at me! I'm really fine!
Even as the Rathalos's health dwindles, it becomes ever more difficult to appurroach it.
The Originium dust surrounding it has increased in density, exponentially increasing the power of its flames, and its attack patterns are becoming hard to predict.
Its acuity has also increased along with its aggressiveness, and it's no longer easily distracted, making it impossible to sneak attacks in.
Kisama... We're back to square one—it's difficult to close the distance.
Mrow! The Rathalos isn't facing us anymore!
That direction is...
It turned towards the temporary shelter, but the villagers are still waiting to be evacuated...
*Huff*—*huff*—energy into blade, energy as blade...
Noir Corne! Don't get distracted! We have to figure out a way to stop its advance!

Your long sword... even though it's not easy to control the direction of your swings, I should be able to use it as a springboard to approach the Rathalos just like before. This time I'll aim for its weakspot and stop it in its tracks!
But with the Rathalos enraged, your meowjesty will be completely exposed to its attacks, and will mostly likely have to tackle it head-on...
There's no time! Just go with my plan, Corne!
Yato...
What? Hurry!
Listen, it took a heavy blow to its skull, and although it looks like it's already recovered from that, its jaw is moving differently now!
We should wait for just the right moment to aim for its head and deal a knock-out blow.
But given the current situation, our odds of getting a good angle are nearly zero.
If we can manage to knock it down though... that would be a good enough chance, right?
It would, but— Corne! What are you doing?
I'm going to create that chance! Palico, I'll use that move you told me about! Even though it's real difficult...
Believe in me! Only I can do it!
I believe in you too, Yato! That only you can seize this chance!
I will.
Good.
Control the blade, and aim for the enemy with your energy to unleash an even stronger power.
Energy as blade, and aim for the enemy...
Ah! What was it?! That one move...
The one the Palico taught me, similar to the one I was trained in, the most convenient move to chop things with!
Your meowjesty! While the Rathalos is injured, use the Spirit Slash I mentioned!
Ah, right! Alright, I got it! Next, hold the blade near the waist during the attack!
And then—unsheathe!
Iai Spirit Slash!
It hit!
Your meowjesty! The time has come!
I remember now! The Long Sword's strongest move! I can feel the call of that power!
Its name is—
Hyarrrrggggggghh!!
Spirit Helm Breaker! Hah!
Noir Corne leapt onto the Rathalos, using his momentum to launch himself into the air.
As if pulled by an invisible wire, his body was hurled high up into the sky.
His energy accumulates, condensing into the smallest speck at the highest point.
And then—it bursts.
With a speed meant for thousands of kilometers, he slashes downward at the Rathalos's body.
So much ash...I can't make anything out! Corne! Are you alright?
I... I'm good, but my body kinda doesn't want to move...
He pulled off the Spirit Helm Breaker in such a short time, how ameowzing!
But the Rathalos is too perceptive, and made a counterattack.
Make way for meow! Smithy, it's our turn to pull out the cart again! Here we go! Quickly, throw Noir Corne on top!
Smithy, what are you doing? That's not Noir Corne!
That is...mrow!
The Rathalos's tail! He chopped it off! It's fallen!
This is your best chance!
No time for hesitation... I'm moving in.
Ahh—quick, bring Noir Corne away! Don't interfur with my note-taking!
I'm leaving the rest to you, Yato.
(The wound... where is it? Somewhere in the lower jaw...)
(Curses, there's so much dust swirling around, visibility is so poor...)
(Found it! There!)
I'll finish you off here!
Your meowjesty! Purrlease stop!
Ngh—Damn it! I lost the perfect chance!
To actually recover so quickly even with its tail cut off, this Rathalos is truly incredible.
Ah...
It's about to take flight! The direction... it seems it's still heading toward the temporary shelter!
Is there no way to knock it down? There must be, right? Palico?
Your meowjesty, the only thing that could work now would be a Flash Bomb, but mine broke befur I came here.
With our current resources, we have no way of fighting it if it doesn't come down to attack us.
Then are we going to just stand and watch it destroy everything? Waste all of our efforts?
No... it can't end like this!

The most important lesson from the Hunters who've fought these monsters throughout the ages with their own flesh and blood is that we must drag them into our hunting grounds to be able to compete with these creatures beyond imagination.
The Rathalos is the King of the Skies, so the sky is its territory...
There... might be no way to stop one like this.
Hey! Smithy! Don't go over there, it's dangerous!
One tool that works just like a Flash Bomb, right here fur mew!
What are you saying...
Mew managed to craft one?
It's beclaws of this.
I found some local Originium slugs in the stinky fowls' nest earlier that can emit a purrdy strong light!
I mixed some other meowterials in and bang! Crafted a Flash Bomb kind of tool!
Your meowjesty! This is the ultimate weapon against a Rathalos!
Throw it at its head and it will explode with a blinding light. Remeowmber to shield your eyes!
It's like throwing a grenade, right? I got it.
Mew can call it the Shiny Flash 'nade!
Mhm.
Pass it to me!
(Aiming)
Fall!
Mew did it! The Rathalos has fallen out of the sky!
Palico, what's the most... effective move to use on the Rathalos with these Dual Blades I'm using?
The Midair Spinning Blade Dance! Mew must first enter Demon Mode, and then jump in the direction you want to attack...
Skip to the important part!
Spin your Dual Blades in the most violent way and dance through the air!
Blade dance...
(An opening... I need to find one...)
A mid-air blade dance...
Eat meow blade!
Rathalos!
I'm here!
I'm your opponent!
She rushed straight in, with nothing but her quarry in her eyes.
The dual blades spun and twirled in the air, slicing through the smoke and dust.
Her body whirled through the air, as if dancing.
We managed to tie it up! It is fortunate I learnt a meowthod of binding monsters in an eastern village...
Did we do it?
Finally... victory.
Your meowjesty, it will be difficult to keep it trapped for too long, so mew must decide what to do posthaste!
I... I know.
Previously, I had thought the Rathalos should not be your target, but after having hunted side-by-side with mew, I have changed my mind.
I did not understand this great land of yours and the existence of Originium, so I cannot be sure of what other threats the Rathalos may pose in the future.
This is your home, so the decision should be left to mew.
Her gaze swept over the massive body as ashes scattered everywhere from its struggle.
Even though its scales were riddled with scars, its might was still daunting.
What truly impressive vitality...
For the safety of everyone that comes after, I must ensure the threat is eradicated. For that is my duty.
...Let's finish it off.
Yato! Wait!
What's wrong?
*cough* Listen to me, there's no need...
No need to what?
*cough* I'm choking so bad... there's no need for us to end its life.
And your reasoning is?
Because...*cough*
Let meow explain!
Look at the pawrts with the Originium clusters.
Smithy, hand meow the hammer, we will conduct some tapping!
It fell off?
Noir Corne, take this and go test it fur active Originium.

I learnt from the other scholar that the Rathalos's violent tempawrament was a side effect of the Originium's influence, but it's not actually infected, even though it was spreading Originium dust everywhere.
This may not be enough to dispel your doubts, but... I also discovered something very interesting deep in the mine and compawed it with my notes, and have confurmed the following...
In truth, the Rathalos has been fighting against the Originium's influence, and the clusters are a pawduct of its resistance.
Noir Corne, the test results confurm my hypawthesis, yes?
Yeah, these Originium clusters aren't active.
The Rathalos is merely contaminated with active Originium from the area, and as long as it's not in an active Originium zone, will spread no dust on its own.
But we can't guarantee that it won't appear next to an Originium mine in the future, so it's still dangerous. Or do I have to find a way to transport it somewhere and keep it locked up?
No... I purr-omise you it won't fly too far from here.
It's already old, and starvation has worn it out. And after this hunt... it's meowbility is extremely poor now.
I think it went to the Originium mine to try and recover its strength, fur their nests resemble the volcanic area we saw deep inside.
Indeed, I recall seeing it head towards a volcano when I furst spotted it.
And now that I think on it, it must be trying to return from whence it came... Mrow.
Corne... what do you think?
I think... since it no longer poses a threat, and since it didn't attack anyone deliberately...
The Rathalos...
The Rathalos was panting violently, fiery sparks splashing out of its jaws and over its new scars.
Its body was still trembling nonstop, squeezing out the very last of its breath, desperately fighting against its shackles.
That scared the meow out of me! Mew are all tied up and still moving around!
The Catastrophe...is coming closer and closer.
...In the face of a real disaster, we are truly insigniﬁcant.
Palico, you're wrong about one thing.
Mrow?
This land has never belonged to us alone, but also to all the life here that's just trying to survive.
Fighting each other for the chance to live, even if...
They die bravely in the process.
Yato, where are you going?
Reinforcements are almost here, so I'll head to the shelter and help the villagers evacuate.
What about the Rathalos?
I don't waste time on anything unrelated to my mission, since there will always be some other meddler ready to sort things out.
Captain's log number five, this is Rhodes Island Operations Team A4...Captain Yato.

The source of the Originium dust spreading in Roka Village has been dealt with, and the threat has been eliminated. The next step is to complete the evacuation and ensure the villagers are safe from the Catastrophe.
Mission complete, end of recording.
Hurry, lady! The monster is flying away!
Huh? The Rathalos flew away?
Hah, I expected as much.
Is it because those people couldn't defeat it? Were they not strong enough?
No, they're truly strong. They defeated a whole bunch of Originium slugs, after all.
Are Originium slugs the same level as that monster...?
They definitely made the right choice.
It flew away... my moneymaker has flown away...
Get in the car, now. We have yet to settle our accounts.
(Wiping knife)
Akira, you would have done it this way as well, wouldn't you?
I knew you saved a arma-clawbeast cub back then...
It flew away.
It really flew away.
Flew away!
What are you guys dallying about for? Come over and help!
In the end, the hunter didn't defeat the monster.
But the villagers had left, leaving behind only empty ruins to burn in the flames.
Wounded and without a target, the monster roared and bellowed, and returned to the forest on its own.
As though leaving with the parting words:
'I'll be back.'
The hunter stands quietly facing the forest. A long time passes before he answers.
What? The hunter doesn't beat the monster? Lame!
Yeah, he's the greatest hunter in the village! Why couldn't he beat the monster?
That's just how the story goes.
But the Rathalos that attacked the village got away.
It's 'cause they were all too weak. When I become a hunter, I'll chase that Rathalos away in the blink of an eye!
Cut it out! I saw it with my own eyes. You're no match for it!
Look! What do you think this is?
The spear used to hunt the Rathalos!
Yato told me to take care of it for now, which means I'm worthy of carrying it. I'm the one who's gonna be the greatest hunter in the whole village. You just go home and sleep!
I dare you to say that again! Spirit Helm Breaker! Take that!
Alright, kids, that's enough.
What did the hunter say in the end?
Well...
It's time for lunch. Go eat, and I'll continue the hunter's story afterwards.
Go on now.
Mirai... it's already been half a month, but sometimes it feels like it was yesterday.
Your memory is improving.
I've never forgotten about Akira... Is old Kashiwau awake?
Still in a coma, but the doctor says he's gotten a lot better. He has a lot of life in him yet.
Things have been so busy lately, new streets and new houses...
Good thing we'd saved up some money from the Originium mining, and made Hiroshi Ritou cough up the money he embezzled.
The beginning is the easy part though. The question is what kind of industry should the village pursue...
Mirai, can't we try the Suzuka cultivation method you mentioned, once things have settled down?
Oh, I was lying about that.
L-Lying?
You know how sensitive Suzuka herbs are. It's not really feasible to cultivate them outside their native habitat with current technology.
But you said—
You guys would never have been willing to move if I didn't. You lost your wits in the face of danger and Ritou played you like a fiddle. I had to find a way to get people to leave.
The future... Just thinking about the livelihood of the village is making my head hurt.
Actually, I do have an idea.
Really?
Really.
Go ahead then, I'm listening.
We can make use of our experience working in the mines.
We can have our people go out to work in mature Originium projects and bring back safe, established technologies relying on existing supply chains.
Do you realize what you're saying? We finally managed to escape that Originium mine, and now you're trying to send us back in?
Weren't you one who wanted to blow it up?
It wasn't about the mine itself, but the fact that you were digging up more than you could manage, and none of you would listen to reason.
We've been working directly with Originium ore for so long and gained so much experience. That can only come in handy.
Originium is too dangerous. Catastrophe, Oripathy... are we really going to go back to living in fear?
Even so, Uncle, there's nowhere in Terra we can avoid living alongside Originium.
The bright lights of the great cities are fueled by the Originium industry, after all.
It's too late to turn our backs on it and go back to the old ways.
But... how can we...?
Starting over doesn't mean abandoning everything we once had.
What we know about the Originium industry is just the tip of the iceberg. We need to move forward, learn from mature industrial systems, and gain more experience.
